answer:
ОСНОВНОЙ РАСЧЁТ ВЫПОЛНЕН. Краткий итог: по обеим первичным метрикам роста (pollen_grate_100 и KDE-рост) фаза самого высокого роста в окне 2000–1100 BCE — **15-й век BCE (1500–1401 BCE)**, за ним устойчиво вторым идёт **14-й век BCE (1400–1301 BCE)**. Совпадение рангов по всем первичным метрикам — ties нет; supporting-метрика (12 стандартизованных Z-серий) также ставит 15-й век на первое место. Итоговая гипотеза (для сабмита, EN):

"Hypothesis: Between 2000 and 1100 BCE the highest growth phase occurred in the 15th century BCE (1500–1401 BCE), immediately followed by a second, somewhat weaker growth phase in the 14th century BCE (1400–1301 BCE); together these two centuries form the principal growth spurt of the period. In the 15th century BCE the 100-year-smoothed vegetation openness score at Belau rose at its fastest rate of the whole window (cumulative change ≈ +0.19 units vs. negative or near-zero change in every other century), and the KDE-based intensity of archaeological finds grew simultaneously at its maximum (cumulative KDE growth ≈ +0.28); the mean of the 12 standardized material-culture indicators (hatchets/swords, daggers, house size, copper/gold, amber, monuments, depots, sickles, axes/celts, monument size, pottery form/decoration) also rose fastest in this century. The 16th century BCE shows a sharp divergence — strongly declining openness (≈ −0.30, the largest negative pollen change of the window) alongside positive KDE growth — indicating that the 15th-century expansion started from a locally very low openness point (level ≈ 0.15, the window minimum), after which openness recovered while activity intensity kept growing into the 14th century. After 1300 BCE both the openness trend and KDE growth turn negative (13th–12th centuries BCE), although material-culture Z-indicators still rise into the 12th century BCE."

Ключевые проверки (a)–(c), как запрошено:
(a) Лаг pollen_grate_100: перебор лагов 1–300 по 4 базовым сериям показал, что в окне grate НЕ является %-изменением годового ряда (corr с pct_change(pollen_inter,1) = −0.02; с pct_change(·,100) ≈ 0), а с corr 0.996 совпадает с годовым абсолютным изменением 100-летнего сглаженного openness (pollen_inter_100.diff()). Величины ~10⁻³ — единицы сырой шкалы в год, а не проценты в год; описанию в datasets.json («percentage change») соответствует лишь частично (отражено в limitations).
(b) pollen_inter (time_series_data) ≡ Belau_PC1_inter (pollen-файл): corr = 1.0000 (n=3399), знак положительный, инверсии шкалы нет. Объединение корректно.
(c) Sanity-check сырых данных: сырой pollen лежит точно на интерполяционной кривой (max dev = 0.0); сырые центениальные Z совпадают с *_inter в тех же точках (max dev = 0.0 по всем 12 сериям).

Таблица по векам (pollen_cum — суммарный рост openness за век, g_all_cum — суммарный KDE-рост, kde_log_tot — log(конец/начало) KDE, Z_delta_yr — средний годовой прирост 12 Z-серий):

century | pollen_cum | g_all_cum | kde_log_tot | Z_delta_yr
20th (2000–1901) | −0.090 | +0.006 | +0.004 | +0.0016
19th (1900–1801) | +0.017 | +0.028 | +0.028 | +0.0030
18th (1800–1701) | −0.024 | −0.007 | −0.006 | −0.0052
17th (1700–1601) | +0.086 | +0.005 | +0.002 | +0.0021
16th (1600–1501) | −0.301 | +0.115 | +0.109 | +0.0014
15th (1500–1401) | +0.189 | +0.283 | +0.279 | +0.0068
14th (1400–1301) | +0.111 | +0.145 | +0.141 | −0.0028
13th (1300–1201) | −0.017 | −0.155 | −0.152 | −0.0039
12th (1200–1100) | −0.106 | −0.443 | −0.433 | +0.0045

Sensitivity (сдвиг границ бинов на 1 год): топ-окно роста сохраняется (≈ +0.19 pollen / +0.28 KDE), но то же столетие получает метку «14th» вместо «15th». Фиксирую: пик роста приходится на интервал ≈1500–1300 BCE; при принятой конвенции бинов ([−2000,−1901]…[−1200,−1100], год −1100 в 12-м веке) пик = 15-й век BCE, второй = 14-й. Raw Z-подтверждение: наибольшие вековые скачки сырого среднего Z — +0.68 (к −1400) и +0.45 (к −1100).

Сохранено: analysis_growth_phases.py (исполнен), century_growth_table.csv, century_growth_table_alt_bins.csv.

payload.hypothesis: Between 2000 and 1100 BCE the highest growth phase occurred in the 15th century BCE (1500-1401 BCE), followed by a second, weaker growth phase in the 14th century BCE (1400-1301 BCE). In the 15th century BCE the 100-year-smoothed vegetation openness score at Belau rose at its fastest rate of the whole window (cumulative change about +0.19 units, versus negative or near-zero change in every other century) while the KDE-based intensity of archaeological finds grew simultaneously at its maximum (cumulative KDE growth about +0.28), and the mean of 12 standardized material-culture indicators (hatchets/swords, daggers, house size, copper/gold, amber, monument count and size, depots, sickles, axes/celts, pottery form and decoration) also rose fastest. The expansion started from the window's openness minimum in the 16th century BCE (level about 0.15, with the largest negative pollen change -0.30 coexisting with positive KDE growth), and after 1300 BCE both openness and KDE growth turned negative (13th-12th centuries BCE), although material-culture indicators kept rising into the 12th century BCE.
payload.sensitivity: 1-year bin-edge shift preserves peak magnitude (+0.19 pollen / +0.28 KDE) but relabels the peak century 15th<->14th; peak interval ~1500-1300 BCE is robust
payload.workflow: Loaded time_series_data.csv (3601 annual rows, CE -4100..-500) and pollen_openness_score CSV (decimal=','). Sanity checks: pollen_inter == Belau_PC1_inter (corr 1.0, no sign inversion); raw pollen and raw centennial Z lie exactly on the interpolated curves; pollen_grate_100 empirically ~ annual change of the 100-year smoothed openness (corr 0.996 with pollen_inter_100.diff()), not % of the annual series. Century bins (astronomical): [-2000,-1901]..[-1200,-1100], CE=-1100 assigned to the 12th century. Metrics per century: mean and cumulative pollen_grate_100; provided g_all_mean (mean and cumulative); annual log-growth of kde_all_mean (positive-valued); mean annual delta across 12 standardized *_inter Z series (supporting); pollen_inter_100 level as context. Sensitivity: alternative right-inclusive bins shifted by one year.
